crossRefs.note: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen Yahweh yourselves, to serve him.”…
Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
“Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and…
but they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh’s wrath arose…
The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might…
Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

translations.web: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.
translations.bsb: So you are witnesses consenting to the deeds of your fathers: They killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.
translations.kjv: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
translations.asv: So ye are witnesses and consent unto the works of your fathers: for they killed them, and ye build their tombs.
